input.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs without an explicit permissions: block
input.description: Missing permissions block in CI workflow
input.recommendation: Add an explicit permissions block (e.g. contents: read) to all jobs or workflows.

input.description: Untrusted PR head ref checked out under pull_request_target with write permissions
input.evidence: .github/workflows/auto-label.yml uses pull_request_target and checks out ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
input.recommendation: Avoid checking out untrusted PR head refs on pull_request_target workflows, or use pull_request instead.
Pass untrusted event data via environment variables instead of direct shell interpolation.
input.description: Untrusted pull request title interpolated directly into shell run script

input.evidence: .github/workflows/manual-deploy.yml uses ${{ inputs.version }} and ${{ inputs.environment }} directly in shell run script
input.description: Untrusted workflow dispatch inputs interpolated directly into shell run script
input.recommendation: Pass workflow inputs via environment variables instead of direct shell interpolation.

input.description: Hardcoded credential in workflow environment variables block
input.recommendation: Use GitHub Secrets instead of hardcoding API keys or credentials in workflow files.

input.summary: Audited the vulnerable-workflows-test repository. Identified and recorded key GitHub Actions workflow security issues including a pull_request_target checkout of untrusted PR head ref, shell injection via direct interpolation of PR title and workflow dispatch inputs, missing permissions block, and a hardcoded API key in workflow environment variables.
